asked: Given a user enters a valid discount code, when they apply it at checkout, then the total price must be reduced by the specified percentage or amount.

asked: Given a user completes a purchase via Stripe Checkout, when the payment is successful, then the user must be redirected to an order success page.

Given a user selects a shipping destination, when they view the checkout summary, then the shipping rate must be calculated based on the selected country.
Given a user successfully places an order, when the transaction is finalized, then an order confirmation email must be sent to the user's provided email address.
Given an administrator adds a new product to the catalogue, when the product is saved, then a post containing the product details must be automatically published to the shop's Instagram account.
